desc: Parse input: read H, W and H binary strings; convert each row to an integer mask; build a frequency array over masks.
Precompute popcount lookup table for all values in [0, 2^W) using DP.
Compute total cost per column-flip mask via FWHT-based XOR-convolution in O(W·2^W) instead of O(4^W).
Verify edge cases: W=1, all rows identical, H=1, all zeros.
Write the complete Python solution with numpy-vectorized FWHT and pure-Python fallback.
Clean up dead placeholder code in h-table construction; verify on samples (2, 0, 13) and confirm both FWHT paths agree.
